name: RealizationBoundaries.cocycle_identity
type:

  RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S r t + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S (r + t) v =
    RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S t v + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S r (t + v)

name: RealizationBoundaries.cocycle_identity._abel_1_2
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r t v : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r + RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S t -
        RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (r + t) +
      (RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (r + t) + RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S v -
        RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (r + (t + v))) =
    RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S t + RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S v -
        RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (t + v) +
      (RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r + RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (t + v) -
        RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (r + (t + v)))

name: RealizationBoundaries.cocycle_not_removable._abel_1_2
type:
∀ {S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime} (b : ℚ → ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport) (r t : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r + ↑(b r) + (RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S t + ↑(b t)) -
      (RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (r + t) + ↑(b (r + t))) =
    RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r + RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S t -
            RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (r + t) +
          ↑(b r) +
        ↑(b t) -
      ↑(b (r + t))

name: RealizationBoundaries.cocycle_symmetric

  RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S r t = RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S t r

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd.eq_1
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x y = (x.1 + y.1, x.2 + y.2 + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S x.1 y.1)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_assoc
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y z : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S (RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x y) z =
    RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x (RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S y z)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_assoc._abel_1_1
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y z : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  x.2 + y.2 + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S x.1 y.1 + z.2 + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S (x.1 + y.1) z.1 =
    x.2 + y.2 + z.2 + (RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S x.1 y.1 + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S (x.1 + y.1) z.1)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_assoc._abel_1_2
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y z : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  x.2 + y.2 + z.2 + (RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S y.1 z.1 + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S x.1 (y.1 + z.1)) =
    x.2 + (y.2 + z.2 + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S y.1 z.1) + RealizationBoundaries.cocycle S x.1 (y.1 + z.1)

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_comm

∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x y = RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S y x

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_inverse

∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd_zero
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x (0, 0) = x

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate_add
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (x y : ℚ × ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport),
  RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate S (RealizationBoundaries.normalAdd S x y) =
    RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate S x + RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate S y

name: RealizationBoundaries.normalEvaluate_add._abel_1_2
type:

  RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (x.1 + y.1) +
      (↑x.2 + ↑y.2 +
        (RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S x.1 + RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S y.1 -
          RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (x.1 + y.1))) =
    RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S x.1 + ↑x.2 + (RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S y.1 + ↑y.2)

(W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) →
  RealizationBoundaries.Prime → RealizationBoundaries.CompletionIndex W

name: RealizationBoundaries.primeCoordinateIndex._proof_1
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  (RealizationBoundaries.primeCoordinate W p).ker.Normal

name: RealizationBoundaries.primeCoordinateIndex._proof_2
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  (RealizationBoundaries.primeCoordinate W p).ker.FiniteIndex

name: RealizationBoundaries.primeFact
type: ∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), Fact (Nat.Prime ↑p)

name: RealizationBoundaries.primeSeed
type: RealizationBoundaries.Prime → ↥RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.primeSeed._proof_1
type: ∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), (RealizationBoundaries.cut {p} fun x => 1) ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.primeSeed.eq_1
type: ∀ (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), RealizationBoundaries.primeSeed p = ⟨RealizationBoundaries.cut {p} fun x => 1, ⋯⟩

name: RealizationBoundaries.primeSeed_injective
type: Function.Injective RealizationBoundaries.primeSeed

name: RealizationBoundaries.prime_obstruction
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime), ↑p ∣ m → ↑x p ≠ 0 → ¬∃ y, m • y = x

name: RealizationBoundaries.profiniteCompletionEquiv
type:
(W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) →
  ↑(RealizationBoundaries.CanonicalCompletion W).toProfinite.toTop ≃ₜ+ RealizationBoundaries.Ambient

name: RealizationBoundaries.profiniteCompletionEquiv._proof_1
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace)
  (x y : ↑(RealizationBoundaries.CanonicalCompletion W).toProfinite.toTop),
  (RealizationBoundaries.completionToAmbient W) (x + y) =
    (RealizationBoundaries.completionToAmbient W) x + (RealizationBoundaries.completionToAmbient W) y

name: RealizationBoundaries.profiniteCompletionEquiv_eta
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (x : ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)),
  (RealizationBoundaries.profiniteCompletionEquiv W)
      (ProfiniteAddGrp.ProfiniteCompletion.etaFn (AddGrpCat.of ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)) x) =
    ↑x

name: RealizationBoundaries.purePreimageOrderIso
type: Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace ≃o RealizationBoundaries.PureIntermediate

name: RealizationBoundaries.purePreimageOrderIso._proof_1
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ RealizationBoundaries.preimage W ∧
    RealizationBoundaries.IsPure (RealizationBoundaries.preimage W)

name: RealizationBoundaries.purePreimageOrderIso._proof_2
type: ∀ (H : RealizationBoundaries.PureIntermediate), RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ ↑H

name: RealizationBoundaries.purePreimageOrderIso._proof_3
type: ∀ (H : RealizationBoundaries.PureIntermediate), RealizationBoundaries.IsPure ↑H

name: RealizationBoundaries.purePreimageOrderIso._proof_4
type:
∀ (H : RealizationBoundaries.PureIntermediate),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ RealizationBoundaries.preimage (RealizationBoundaries.rationalImage ↑H ⋯ ⋯) ∧
    RealizationBoundaries.IsPure (RealizationBoundaries.preimage (RealizationBoundaries.rationalImage ↑H ⋯ ⋯))

name: RealizationBoundaries.purePreimageOrderIso._proof_5
type:
∀ (H : RealizationBoundaries.PureIntermediate),
  ⟨RealizationBoundaries.preimage (RealizationBoundaries.rationalImage ↑H ⋯ ⋯), ⋯⟩ = H

name: RealizationBoundaries.pure_root_closed
type:
∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ H →
    RealizationBoundaries.IsPure H → ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), m • x ∈ H → x ∈ H

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap
type: RealizationBoundaries.Ambient →+ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap._proof_1
type: RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport.Normal

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap_eq_iff
type:
∀ (x y : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap x = RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap y ↔
    x - y ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap_eq_zero_iff
type: ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap x = 0 ↔ x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap_eq_zero_iff._simp_1
type:
∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  (RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap x = 0) = (x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport)

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap_rationalSection
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap (RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r) =
    r • RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap (RealizationBoundaries.indicator S)

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap_surjective
type: Function.Surjective ⇑RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotientProjection
type:
(W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) →
  (K : RealizationBoundaries.CompletionIndex W) →
    ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) ⧸ K.toAddSubgroup

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotientProjection._proof_1
type: ∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) (K : RealizationBoundaries.CompletionIndex W), K.Normal

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotientTransition
type:
(W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) →
  {K L : RealizationBoundaries.CompletionIndex W} →
    K ≤ L →
      ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) ⧸ K.toAddSubgroup →+ ↥(RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) ⧸ L.toAddSubgroup

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotientTransition_projection
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) {K L : RealizationBoundaries.CompletionIndex W} (h : K ≤ L),
  (RealizationBoundaries.quotientTransition W h).comp (RealizationBoundaries.quotientProjection W K) =
    RealizationBoundaries.quotientProjection W L

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotient_image_nsmul_closed
type:
∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ H →
    RealizationBoundaries.IsPure H →
      ∀ {m : ℕ},
        0 < m →
          ∀ (v : RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace),
            m • v ∈ AddSubgroup.map RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap H →
              v ∈ AddSubgroup.map RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap H

name: RealizationBoundaries.quotient_image_smul_mem
type:
∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient),
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ H →
    RealizationBoundaries.IsPure H →
      ∀ (r : ℚ),
        ∀ v ∈ AddSubgroup.map RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap H,
          r • v ∈ AddSubgroup.map RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap H

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalImage
type:
(H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) →
  RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport ≤ H → RealizationBoundaries.IsPure H → Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalImage._proof_1
type:
∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient) {a b : RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace},
  a ∈ AddSubgroup.map RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap H →
    b ∈ AddSubgroup.map RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap H →
      a + b ∈ AddSubgroup.map RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap H

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalImage._proof_2
type: ∀ (H : AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), 0 ∈ AddSubgroup.map RealizationBoundaries.quotientMap H

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalImage_preimage
type:
∀ (W : Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace),
  RealizationBoundaries.rationalImage (RealizationBoundaries.preimage W) ⋯ ⋯ = W

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection
type: Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime → ℚ → RealizationBoundaries.Ambient

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection.eq_1
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r : ℚ) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r p = if p ∈ S then ↑r else 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection_denominator_defect
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r : ℚ),
  r.den • RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r - r.num • RealizationBoundaries.indicator S ∈
    RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection_denominator_zero
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r : ℚ) (p : RealizationBoundaries.Prime),
  ↑p ∣ r.den → RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r p = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection_mem
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r ∈ RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection_neg
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (-r) = -RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection_one
type: ∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime), RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S 1 = RealizationBoundaries.indicator S

name: RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection_zero
type: ∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime), RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S 0 = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.rational_hom_zero
type: ∀ (E : Type u_1) [inst : AddCommGroup E] [_root_.Module ℚ E] (f : E →+ RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), f = 0

name: RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect
type: Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime → ℚ → ℚ → RealizationBoundaries.Ambient

name: RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect.eq_1
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r t : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect S r t =
    RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S r + RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S t -
      RealizationBoundaries.rationalSection S (r + t)

name: RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect_finite
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r t : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect S r t ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport

name: RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect_support
type:
∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime) (r t : ℚ),
  RealizationBoundaries.support (RealizationBoundaries.sectionDefect S r t) ⊆
    RealizationBoundaries.exceptional (r.den * t.den)

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup
type: Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime → AddSubgroup RealizationBoundaries.Ambient

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup_countable
type: ∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime), Countable ↥(RealizationBoundaries.selectorGroup S)

name: RealizationBoundaries.selectorLine
type: Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime → Submodule ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace

name: RealizationBoundaries.support
type: RealizationBoundaries.Ambient → Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime

name: RealizationBoundaries.support.eq_1
type: ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), RealizationBoundaries.support x = {p | x p ≠ 0}

name: RealizationBoundaries.support_indicator
type: ∀ (S : Set RealizationBoundaries.Prime), RealizationBoundaries.support (RealizationBoundaries.indicator S) = S

name: RealizationBoundaries.tailAddCommGroup
type: AddCommGroup RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace

name: RealizationBoundaries.tailDivisibleEquiv
type: RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace ≃+ DivisibleHull RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace

name: RealizationBoundaries.tailDivisibleEquiv._proof_1
type:
AddHomClass (RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace →+ DivisibleHull RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace)
  RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace (DivisibleHull RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace)

name: RealizationBoundaries.tailDivisibleEquiv._proof_2
type:
Function.Injective ⇑(DivisibleHull.coeAddMonoidHom RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace) ∧
  Function.Surjective ⇑(DivisibleHull.coeAddMonoidHom RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace)

name: RealizationBoundaries.tailRationalModule
type: _root_.Module ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace

name: RealizationBoundaries.tail_denominator_clear
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → ∀ (v : RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace), m • (↑m)⁻¹ • v = v

name: RealizationBoundaries.tail_nsmul_bijective
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → Function.Bijective fun v => m • v

name: RealizationBoundaries.tail_nsmul_injective
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → Function.Injective fun v => m • v

name: RealizationBoundaries.tail_nsmul_surjective
type: ∀ {m : ℕ}, 0 < m → Function.Surjective fun v => m • v

name: RealizationBoundaries.tail_rational_module_unique
type: Subsingleton (_root_.Module ℚ RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace)

name: RealizationBoundaries.tail_to_divisibleHull_surjective
type: Function.Surjective ⇑(DivisibleHull.coeAddMonoidHom RealizationBoundaries.TailSpace)

name: RealizationBoundaries.torsion_iff_finiteSupport
type: ∀ (x : RealizationBoundaries.Ambient), (∃ m, 0 < m ∧ m • x = 0) ↔ x ∈ RealizationBoundaries.finiteSupport
